title: Open Book
description: Feature flags aren't admin-only secrets at SwiftCargo — other pages read them too, so the console just shows the truth plainly. Confirm the Feature Flags panel renders every known flag with a legible on/off badge.
successCondition: Logged in as any authenticated user who can reach /admin, the Feature Flags panel renders exactly three rows — priorityLane, extendedTracking, newAdminUi — each showing the flag key text and a Badge reading "on" (success tone) or "off" (neutral tone) matching the API's current value.
hints: The panel is the first card on the Admin console page, above Bulk Actions.
Badge tone is driven directly by the boolean value returned from GET /api/admin/feature-flags — no separate loading state to race.
